nd4c2baca3b.why: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, so its chief executive's views on trade policy carry weight with global institutional investors. Tariffs can affect corporate earnings, supply chains and inflation.

na92da35fae.headline: Starmer urged to confront Trump over tariffs as UK braces for trade blow
na92da35fae.summary: Prime Minister Keir Starmer faces pressure to stand up to Donald Trump as US tariff threats loom, risking a global trade war that could wipe out the UK's £9.9bn fiscal headroom.

na19e633016.headline: WTI Oil Rises and on Growing Threats About New Tariffs and Potential Military Confrontation with Iran
na19e633016.summary: WTI oil firmed on Monday and broke through the $70 barrier, where bulls were capped last week. Growing threats around new tariffs and a potential military confrontation with Iran were cited.
